q1.explanationZh: historical 形容词“历史的；有关历史的”，historic 则是“有历史意义的”。

q2.explanationZh: history 名词“历史”，形容词是 historical / historic。

q3.explanationZh: hit 作动词“击；碰撞”，作名词还可指“轰动一时的人或事物”，过去式、过去分词都是 hit。

q4.explanationZh: hitech = high tech, high technology“高技术”。

q5.explanationZh: hobby 名词“业余爱好”，复数是 hobbies。

q6.explanationZh: hold 可作及物、不及物动词和名词，“抓住；举行”，过去式、过去分词都是 held。

q7.explanationZh: hole 名词“洞”，注意与 whole“整个的”区分。

q8.explanationZh: holiday 名词“假日；假期”，on holiday“在度假”。

q9.explanationZh: hollow 作形容词“空心的；凹陷的”，作名词“凹陷处；洞”。

q10.explanationZh: holy 形容词“神圣的；虔诚的”，作名词可指“圣地；圣殿”。

q11.explanationZh: home 名词“家”，也可作副词“在家；回家”，所以 go home 前不加 to。

q12.explanationZh: home + land 构成 homeland“祖国；故乡”。

q13.explanationZh: home + sick 构成形容词 homesick“想家的”。

q14.explanationZh: home + town 构成 hometown“家乡”。

q15.explanationZh: homework“家庭作业”是不可数名词，不加 -s。

q16.explanationZh: honest 的 h 不发音，前面用 an：an honest face；名词是 honesty。

q17.explanationZh: honey 名词“蜂蜜”，也可用作称呼“亲爱的”。

q18.explanationZh: honey + moon 构成 honeymoon“蜜月”，be on one’s honeymoon“在度蜜月”。

q19.explanationZh: honour 是英式拼法，honor 是美式拼法，都对；h 不发音，前面用 an。

q20.explanationZh: honour 加 -able 构成形容词 honourable“可尊敬的；光荣的”，美式拼作 honorable。

q21.explanationZh: hook 名词“钩”，也可作动词“钩住”。

q22.explanationZh: hop“单足跳；跳过”，过去式 hopped 要双写 p；注意与 hope 区分。

q23.explanationZh: hope 动词、名词同形，“希望”，常用 hope to do / hope that ...。

q24.explanationZh: horizon“地平线”，broaden one’s horizons“开阔眼界”常用复数。

q25.explanationZh: horn 名词“喇叭”，blare the horn“按喇叭”。

q26.explanationZh: horrible 形容词“可怕的”，与名词 horror 同源，-ible 结尾。

q27.explanationZh: horror 名词“恐怖；恐惧”，形容词是 horrible。

q29.explanationZh: hospital 名词“医院”，go to (the) hospital“去医院看病”。

q30.explanationZh: host 名词“主人；主持人”，也可作动词“主办；主持”。

q31.explanationZh: hostage 名词“人质”，hold sb. hostage“扣押某人作人质”。

q32.explanationZh: host 加 -ess 构成表示女性的名词 hostess“女主人”。

q33.explanationZh: hit at“试图打中，向……打去；抨击”。

q34.explanationZh: hold on 打电话时表示“别挂断”，也指“抓牢；坚持”。

q35.explanationZh: hold out“伸出；提供；（供应品）维持”。

q36.explanationZh: hold up“举起；耽搁”，be held up“被耽搁”。

q37.explanationZh: on holiday“在度假”，介词用 on，holiday 前不加冠词。

q38.explanationZh: hope for + 名词“希望得到……”。

q39.explanationZh: in honour of“为纪念……；为向……表示敬意”，美式拼作 honor。

q40.explanationZh: hope 后接不定式 hope to do sth.，不说 hope sb. to do sth.。

q42.explanationZh: honour 的 h 不发音，所以用 an；It’s an honour that ...“……是一件很光荣的事”，that 引导主语从句。

q43.explanationZh: honest 以元音音素开头，前面用 an。

q44.explanationZh: holy 形容词“神圣的；圣洁的”，holy love“圣洁的爱”。

q45.explanationZh: go to hospital 英式常不加 the，表示“去医院看病”；美式说 go to the hospital。

accept: take sb. to a place for one’s holidays
take sb to a place for one’s holidays
take sb. to a place for sb.’s holidays

q46.explanationZh: take sb. to ...“带某人去……”；for one’s holidays“去度假”。

q47.explanationZh: a host of + 复数名词“大量的，许多的”。

q48.explanationZh: hit“袭击”，与 caused 并列用过去式，hit 的过去式仍是 hit。

q49.explanationZh: “用高技术制作”，by 后接名词 hitech。

q50.explanationZh: 听到“要放假”的消息很兴奋，have a holiday“放假”。

q51.explanationZh: 松鼠用“树洞”藏坚果，a 后用名词 hollow“洞”。

q52.explanationZh: give up hope“放弃希望”，hope 作不可数名词。

q53.explanationZh: 会议“由我们大学主办”，被动语态 was + 过去分词 hosted。

q54.explanationZh: 修饰名词 accident 用形容词 horrible“可怕的”。

q55.explanationZh: 仪式“被举行”，would be + 过去分词，hold 的过去分词是 held。

q56.explanationZh: go home“回家”，home 是副词，前面不加 to。

q57.explanationZh: 谚语 Where there is life, there is hope.“生命不息，希望常在。”

q58.sampleAnswer: It is a historic meeting between the two leaders.
references: It is a historic meeting between the two leaders.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “具有历史意义的”用 historic，不用 historical；“两者之间”用 between。

q59.sampleAnswer: The designer has integrated sustainable concepts into the renovation of the historical building, ensuring that the building not only meets environmental standards but also retains its cultural and historical significance.
references: The designer has integrated sustainable concepts into the renovation of the historical building, ensuring that the building not only meets environmental standards but also retains its cultural and historical significance.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “历史建筑”= historical building；“把……融入……”= integrate ... into ...；“既……又……”= not only ... but also ...；ensuring 是现在分词作结果状语。

q60.sampleAnswer: Holding iron spades and water buckets, students shared out the work and helped each other, and finished the tree-planting tasks.
references: Holding iron spades and water buckets, students shared out the work and helped each other, and finished the tree-planting tasks.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “拿着……”用现在分词 Holding 作伴随状语；“分工”= share out the work。

q61.sampleAnswer: He came to miss his homeland when he settled down abroad.
references: He came to miss his homeland when he settled down abroad.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “开始想念”= come to miss；“祖国”= homeland；“安定下来”= settle down。

q62.sampleAnswer: The sun has sunk below the horizon.
references: The sun has sunk below the horizon.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “沉到……以下”= sink below；“已经”用现在完成时，sink 的过去分词是 sunk。

q63.sampleAnswer: It’s an honour that I have been invited to such an important meeting.
references: It’s an honour that I have been invited to such an important meeting.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “……是一件荣幸的事”= It’s an honour that ...；honour 的 h 不发音，用 an；“被邀请”用被动语态。

q64.sampleAnswer: Every designer hopes that his work can stand the test of time.
references: Every designer hopes that his work can stand the test of time.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: every designer 作主语，谓语用第三人称单数 hopes；“经受住时间的考验”= stand the test of time。

q65.sampleAnswer: The doctors in that hospital always examine patients with great care.
references: The doctors in that hospital always examine patients with great care.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “该医院的医生”= the doctors in that hospital；“非常仔细地”= with great care。

q66.sampleAnswer: Taking up one or two hobbies is very valuable to people’s mental and physical health.
references: Taking up one or two hobbies is very valuable to people’s mental and physical health.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: 动名词短语 Taking up ... hobbies 作主语，谓语用单数 is；“培养爱好”= take up a hobby。

q67.sampleAnswer: Not only did the visitors from home and abroad appreciate the beauty of the ancient city, but they also had a rough idea of the local traditional culture and the long history.
references: Not only did the visitors from home and abroad appreciate the beauty of the ancient city, but they also had a rough idea of the local traditional culture and the long history.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “中外”= from home and abroad；Not only 放句首时前半句倒装（did ... appreciate），but 后面的分句不倒装。
